title: The order of an ML project
summary: Put the steps of a supervised project in order, so no test data leaks.

items.text: Compare models and settings on the validation set
Split the data into training, validation and test sets
Deploy, and monitor the inputs and errors in use
Fit preprocessing (scaling, encodings) on the training set only
Define the prediction target and the metric that matters
Score the chosen model on the test set, once
Train candidate models on the training set
